source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>pcie.port_map() 6. Check PCIe slot target >>>ei.injectPcieError(socket, port, errType='uce',) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie error 3. Front Panel fault Light may light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie error if there is one
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- PCIe slot 1~N (Intel uncorrectable non-fatal on PCIe slot 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'uncorrected|non.fatal|MCE_'; echo __uncorrectable_non-fatal_on_PCIe_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject an uncorrectable non-fatal PCIe error into every approved physical slot and prove the designated AER/WHEA non-fatal path, continued host operation and bounded endpoint/link recovery with platform-defined indicator behavior.
required_package: PCIe slot to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port coverage
Endpoint identity/workload and independent management path
ITP/CScripts build/hash, exact injected AER bit and `uce` semantics
Severity/mask policy plus Windows WHEA/AER, link/device recovery and indicator oracle
Abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: The FAE maps physical slot and endpoint/root-port BDF to a Cscript socket/port, confirms the selected error bit is unmasked and classified non-fatal, quiesces the endpoint, performs one UCE injection, then correlates AER/WHEA/register state with link/device recovery, optional management logs and physical indication before restoring settings.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie error 3. Front Panel fault Light may light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie error if there is one
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for PCIe slot 1~N. The protected Criteria is `1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie error 3. Front Panel fault Light may light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie error if there is one`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row 32 Wistron-System RAS-00752-V003: approve PCIe slot-to-endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port coverage, ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact `uce` AER bit; define current mask/severity/DPC policy proving non-fatal behavior, mandatory Windows WHEA/AER and link/device recovery when management logs/LED are optional, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.
safety_gate: Prove targeted bit is unmasked and non-fatal in current policy
One injection per freshly mapped slot with link/device monitoring
Abort on fatal escalation, host hang/reset, link loss, wrong target or persistent device failure
No retry; preserve evidence and restore settings/device health
expected_evidence: Endpoint/workload precheck, package hash and exact AER bit
Pre/post severity/mask/DPC and full injection transcript
Windows WHEA/AER plus link/device/driver recovery and applicable BMC/UEFI/indicator evidence
Restoration, residual-error check and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Because BMC/UEFI and the front-panel are all optional in the source, current AER/WHEA/register evidence plus continued host and endpoint health must be the mandatory acceptance core.

source_conflict.reason: Slot 1~N lacks a coverage map; `uce` does not define the injected AER bit or prove non-fatal severity; all BMC/UEFI/indicator outcomes are optional; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and DeepSeek's MCE grep is not a deterministic PCIe AER oracle.
